name: ket-prep-team
description: A top-tier KET exam prep team for young learners, covering full-cycle preparation from baseline assessment to exam day simulation.

displayDescription.en: A team of certified Cambridge examiners and senior young-learner educators delivering full-cycle KET prep: diagnostic assessment, vocabulary & grammar foundations, all four skills training, and full mock exam simulation.
displayDescription.zh: 剑桥认证考官领衔，为小学生提供KET全流程备考：学情测评、词汇语法地基、听说读写专项提分、考前冲刺模考，助力Merit（优秀）/Distinction（卓越）达标。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 你好！请帮我评估孩子的英语现状，并制定一份KET备考计划。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hi! Please help me assess my child's current English level and create a KET study plan.

quickPrompts.en: Hi! Please help me assess my child's current English level and create a KET study plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 你好！请帮我评估孩子的英语现状，并制定一份KET备考计划。

quickPrompts.en: My child struggles with KET listening traps and writing prompts. What's the best way to improve?
quickPrompts.zh: 孩子在KET听力陷阱题和写作提示点覆盖上总是失分，怎么针对性提升？

quickPrompts.en: We have 3 months until the KET exam. Please give us a sprint plan for the final stage.
quickPrompts.zh: 距离KET考试还有3个月，请给我们制定一份考前冲刺计划。
